mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a sudden increase in discount rates, compressing the present value of expected equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 80% of rate hike episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year window.
